context.transcript:
Welcome to Mickleton Bicycle Tours, everybody! My name
is Jane, and i'll be leading your afternoon ride. Seeing the
city by bicycle is a fun and unique way to experience the
area. But, before we go on the tour, there are a couple things
you need to do. First, everyone should go pick out a bike
from our main building. Our staff is available to help you
select one that will be comfortable for your ride today.
And be sure to pick up a helmet at the same time. Oh, and
remember—you don't need to bring any food. We'll be
handing out snacks throughout the afternoon.
